title: (Junior) Social Media Manager (m/f/d)
description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a (Junior) Social Media Manager, you will help shape engaging, trend-driven content for one of Europe’s leading Home & Living brands. We are looking for a highly creative and digitally savvy team member with a strong eye for design, a passion for social media, and a deep understanding of internet culture and emerging trends. In this role, you will support the creation of social-first content across Instagram, contribute creative ideas, and help bring campaigns and storytelling concepts to life. You’ll work closely with Social Media Managers, Creative teams, influencers, and external partners in a fast-paced and highly collaborative environment. We’re looking for someone who is not only visually strong, but also naturally plugged into what’s trending online, from formats and creators to AI tools and new platform developments. This position is permanent and based in Munich.

WHAT YOU'LL DO


 * Support the Instagram team in creating visually engaging social assets
 * Design social-first graphics and creative visuals for Instagram
 * Edit and adapt content for different social platforms and formats
 * Support post-production and asset optimisation for social media
 * Stay up-to-date with social media trends, viral formats, and internet culture
 * Research emerging trends, creators, and AI tools
 * Collaborate closely with Social Media, Creative, and Brand teams
 * Identify new visual and creative opportunities for social content
   
   

YOU COME WITH


 * Passion for social media, digital culture, and emerging trends, as well as at least the first working experience in the field
 * Strong graphic design and post-production skills, and understanding of Instagram and social-first content
 * Interest and knowledge in AI tools and creative AI workflows
 * Strong aesthetic sense and attention to detail
 * Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Canva, CapCut, or similar tools
 * Fluency in British English
   
   

WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.

At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:


 * A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
 * An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
 * A flexible hybrid setup with 3 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen
 * Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas

title: Content & Inbound Marketing Specialist (REMOTE - WORLDWIDE)
description:
REPLUG is a leading mobile app marketing agency helping apps scale through App Store Optimization, Paid Acquisition, Performance-based advertising and Creative Strategy. We work with top brands and ambitious startups, providing data-driven strategies, hands-on expertise, and a no-BS approach to growth.


We are seeking a talented and motivated Content & Inbound Marketing Specialist to strengthen execution within our marketing function.


This is an execution-focused role for someone who enjoys turning direction into action and taking ownership of how content is distributed, tested, and improved.


Beyond repurposing, you will support social growth, short-form video, channel experimentation, and PR/outreach activities.


You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, contributing ideas, and helping marketing efforts move forward.


Tasks


Content Execution & Publishing


   
   
 * Own the execution of REPLUG’s LinkedIn and related channels, ensuring content is consistently published, optimized, and improved over time.
   
   
 * Turn raw inputs (notes, transcripts, drafts, articles) into engaging posts, carousels, and short-form video concepts that align with brand guidelines and platform best practices.
   
   
 * Support content distribution by testing formats, hooks, and messaging to improve performance (engagement, reach, conversions).
   
   


Content Editing & Repurposing


   
   
 * Repurpose existing long-form content (articles, documents, presentations) into short-form assets across formats (posts, carousels, video scripts, newsletters).
   
   
 * Edit and refine content to improve clarity, structure, and consistency while adapting it for different channels and audiences.
   
   
 * Ensure content is reusable and can be leveraged across multiple touchpoints (social, email, sales, partnerships).
   
   


Marketing Operations & Support


   
   
 * Own content calendars and publishing workflows across channels
   
   
 * Manage drafts, assets, and scheduling to keep the pipeline moving
   
   
 * Execute and support content across formats (posts, carousels, video, newsletters)
   
   
 * Test formats, hooks, and distribution approaches to improve performance
   
   
 * Support publishing (HubSpot/CMS) and track basic performance to inform next steps
   
   
 * Contribute to channel growth, PR/outreach, and co-marketing execution
   
   


Optional responsibilities may include basic coordination or editing of short-form video content and collaboration with designers on visual assets.


What Success Looks Like


   
   
 * Content is consistently published across channels without needing constant direction
   
   
 * Output is clear, on-brand, and adapted to the platform it’s published on
   
   
 * Content is repurposed across formats (post, carousel, video, newsletter) efficiently
   
   
 * Performance improves over time through testing, iteration, and optimization
   
   
 * LinkedIn and other channels show steady growth in engagement and inbound interest
   
   
 * Marketing execution runs smoothly with minimal oversight
   
   
 * You proactively identify opportunities, suggest ideas, and push initiatives forward
   
   


Requirements


Must-haves


   
   
 * 2+ years of experience in marketing execution roles (content, social, growth, or digital marketing)
   
   
 * Strong B2B exposure (tech, SaaS, or app industry preferred)
   
   
 * Excellent written and spoken English
   
   
 * Solid understanding of LinkedIn and social platforms as growth channels
   
   
 * Experience working with multiple content formats (posts, carousels, short-form video, newsletters)
   
   
 * Ability to take direction and turn it into execution, while also suggesting improvements
   
   
 * Basic understanding of paid and organic performance (LinkedIn, Google, or similar)
   
   
 * Comfortable using tools like HubSpot/CMS for publishing and basic reporting
   
   
 * High attention to detail, strong organization, and ability to manage multiple tasks
   
   


Nice to have


   
   
 * Experience supporting founder-led or expert-driven brands (e.g., LinkedIn, personal brands)
   
   
 * Exposure to performance marketing (LinkedIn, Google) and basic testing mindset
   
   
 * Experience with short-form video creation and editing (e.g., CapCut, Reels, YouTube)
   
   
 * Interest in testing new channels, formats, and distribution strategies
   
   
 * Exposure to PR and co-marketing activities
   
   
 * Strong editorial judgment and ability to maintain content quality across formats
   
   


Benefits

   
   
 * Remote-first working environment
   
   
 * Direct collaboration with senior marketing leadership & founders
   
   
 * Education budget (courses, conferences, certifications)
   
   
 * A culture built on trust, ownership, and results, not politics

title: Commercial Management Trainee (m/w/d)
description:
No Relocation Assistance Offered

Job Number #172400 - Hamburg, Hamburg, Germany

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Ready to smile? Start your international career at Colgate-Palmolive!

Do you want to actively shape the future of the consumer goods market? Then join our team at Colgate-Palmolive and start your international career! We are looking for you to start our 18-month Commercial Management Trainee Program in October 2026.

At Colgate-Palmolive, we bring healthy smiles to the world. Our Trainee Program is your start for an international career. From day one, you take responsibility for your own projects, inspire us with your ideas, and actively shape the market. We believe in your potential and support your personal and professional development through continuous feedback from experienced mentors and leaders - the ideal foundation for your path in our global company.

What you can look forward to:

You will dive deep into the world of commercial management across three exciting stations:


 * Marketing - Brand Management: Expand your knowledge of consumer behavior and develop/optimize holistic activation and advertising concepts for our global brands.
 * Sales: Analyze the German retail business, learn the art of negotiation with customers, and strategically place our products on the shelf.
 * Retail Marketing (International): The heart of your traineeship: You will spend 5 months at one of our international locations. Here, you will support the planning and implementation of international market strategies and actively help shape product launches and relaunches firsthand.
   
   

Actively shape the business growth of our brands: You will take on strategic projects and work closely with internal teams and external partners to successfully implement groundbreaking initiatives.

What we expect from you:


 * You recently completed your Master's or Bachelor's degree (ideally with a background in Business Administration (BWL), Marketing, Sales, or similar fields)
 * You have already gained initial commercial work experience (e.g., internships, working student positions), preferably in a dynamic environment
 * You have international experience (e.g., semester abroad/international internship) or initial professional exposure to global brands
 * You demonstrate strong solution- and customer-oriented thinking, as well as analytical skills and an independent way of working
 * You are communicative and open, enjoy working in a team, and think cross-functionally - while keeping an eye on priorities and deadlines
 * Fluent German and English language skills
   
   

What we offer you:


 * An attractive compensation package and great additional benefits such as the HVV Proficard, Corporate Benefits, meal vouchers, free products of our brands, EGYM Wellpass, supplemental health insurance, workation, and much more…
 * Dog-friendly office in the heart of Hamburg, directly on the Außenalster
 * Close support and guidance throughout the entire program through regular feedback sessions
 * A "Buddy" and a mentor who will help you build a network within the company
 * A dynamic, supportive, and interdisciplinary work environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
 * You have the opportunity to make a difference in one of our employee initiatives, such as Diversity and Inclusion, Sustainability, Mental Health, and more
   
   

Are you ready to give your international career a smile? Then apply today!

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.

Reasonable accommodation during the application process is available for persons with disabilities. Please complete this request form should you require accommodation.

title: Working Student Creative (all genders)
description:
We are looking for a motivated and culturally plugged-in working student to join our HS+ creative team in Berlin. In this role, you will support the development of content campaigns and event activations that help brands tell meaningful stories. Alongside a passion for storytelling, you should bring curiosity, creativity, and a strong connection to contemporary culture - especially within Berlin’s dynamic creative landscape.

Your Mission


 * Support the creative team in developing concepts across social media, video, and event activations
 * Assist in turning ideas into strong, visually compelling client presentations and decks
 * Contribute to brainstorming sessions and help shape culturally relevant and innovative responses to client briefs
 * Support the creative and production team in bringing creative concepts to life with high attention to detail
 * Research trends, subcultures, and insights - particularly within Berlin and broader European youth culture -to inform creative work
   
   

Your Profile & Skills


 * Currently enrolled in a university program in Germany (e.g. design, marketing, communication, media, or cultural studies)
 * Available to work up to 20 hours per week (Werkstudent framework)
 * Ideally some first experience through internships, freelance work, or personal creative projects
 * Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Keynote (or similar tools)
 * Strong interest in conceptual thinking and storytelling; basic copywriting skills are a plus
 * Good understanding of the digital media landscape and how content is created and distributed
 * Structured, reliable, and comfortable working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment
 * Fluent in English; German is a plus but not required
 * A strong understanding of what Highsnobiety represents
 * Deep interest in fashion, music, design, and youth culture - especially within Berlin’s creative scene
 * Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn and contribute ideas
 * A hands-on, can-do attitude and openness to new challenges
   
   

What We Offer


 * A bright and spacious design office, which reflects our brand and focuses on employee well-being and sustainability, located close to U Kurfüstenstrasse
 * The opportunity to shape the company and help build a global brand in a motivating, international and diverse work atmosphere
 * High degree of responsibility, creativity, originality, independence and creative autonomy
 * We are constantly prioritizing attention on DEIB with internal trainings, workshops, parent friendly policies and our Employee Resource Groups (HighPower, HighPride, HighDreams & HighCulture)
 * 2 extra days off globally for all employees on International Women's Day and Juneteenth
 * Flexible hybrid working policy, dog friendly office, and remote international working benefit
 * Attractive employee benefits (e.g. ClassPass, OpenUp)
   
   

We’re looking forward to hearing from you!!

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Highsnobiety is a global community of independent-minded creatives & professionals: Every perspective matters. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, or genetic information. So if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways.

Highsnobiety is a global brand, sitting at the heart of culture that unites community, content and commerce.

Over the 19 years, our editorial and curatorial perspective has grown a community of Cultural Pioneers, a group whose social influence and ability to shape culture has become impossible to ignore.

For this audience, Highsnobiety is a destination to be kept ahead of the curve; a place to read and shop the latest stories, brands and products.

We are constantly investigating their relationship to a landscape we coined The New Luxury; a mindset that places stories over product and cultural knowledge over material possession.

What we’ve learnt from this community, we also share with our brand partners, ensuring they too can future-proof their business for tomorrow’s culture.

The Highsnobiety agency offers an end-to-end solution for brands, from consumer insights; strategy and consultancy; creative concepts and production and media.

title: Restaurant Onboarding Specialist (m/f/x)
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our Onboarding team is the first step in our restaurant partners’ Wolt journey — and as a Specialist, you’ll make sure that journey starts off better than they ever imagined. You’ll be the go-to person for some of our most high-profile and strategically important acquired partners, guiding them through their onboarding, making them feel at home on Wolt, and setting them up for long-term success.

But you won’t stop there. You’ll also get stuck into projects that improve how we work, making our onboarding process faster, smoother, and even more delightful for every partner who joins us.

If you’re the kind of person who can juggle details without losing sight of the big picture, loves building great relationships, and is always looking for ways to make things better — this might just be your next adventure.

What you’ll be doing


 * Own the onboarding experience for high-profile and strategically important restaurant partners, ensuring every step meets Wolt’s highest standards.
 * Lead and deliver projects that make our onboarding process more efficient, more scalable, and more partner-friendly.
 * Act as the main point of contact for partners during onboarding — training them on our tools, sharing best practices, and making sure they feel confident from day one.
 * Work hand-in-hand with sales, operations, and account management teams to guarantee a smooth handover and a strong start for every partner.
 * Keep a close eye on quality and partner satisfaction in the first months, stepping in to solve problems before they become roadblocks.
 * Use our data and insights to spot growth opportunities for partners and recommend ways to make the most of them.
 * Ensure every venue’s content and visuals on the platform are accurate, engaging, and aligned with the Wolt brand.
 * Share your know-how with the team, helping newer onboarding colleagues grow and thrive.
   
   

Our humble expectations


 * Experience in onboarding, account management, or partner-facing operations — ideally with high-value clients.
 * Strong project management skills, from planning to execution.
 * Great communication and relationship-building abilities, with a knack for creating trust and keeping things moving.
 * Detail-oriented, organized, and able to juggle multiple priorities without breaking a sweat.
 * Data-savvy with solid problem-solving skills and a “let’s make it happen” mindset.
 * Passion for food, restaurants, and delivering top-notch service.
 * Excellent written and spoken German, plus strong English skills.
   
   

Next steps

If we think you could be a great match, we’ll kick things off with a short screening call, then you’ll meet the hiring manager, and finally, you’ll get to show your skills in a case study based on real-life Wolt scenarios.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Brand & Communications Lead (m/w/d)
description:
Welche Aufgaben erwarten mich?

Ich verantworte die Entwicklung von eeden vom Technologieführer zur globalen Ingredient Brand im chemischen Textilrecycling. Mein Ziel: Eine Marke aufzubauen, die in der Industrie Standards setzt und unsere Technologie über alle relevanten Stakeholder hinweg sichtbar und glaubwürdig macht.

Strategie & Markenführung

 * Platzierung unserer Key-Personen als Expert:innen in relevanten Diskursen (Podcasts, Panels, Fachartikel)

Operative Umsetzung


 * Aufbau und Steuerung eines Netzwerks zu globalen Leitmedien

 * Strategische Weiterentwicklung der Unternehmenswebsite
 * Führung des LinkedIn-Auftritts (Corporate und Personal Branding), unterstützt durch Werkstudierende
 * Konzeption und Umsetzung von Messeständen und Event-Präsenzen
 * Auswahl und Steuerung von Agenturen, Freelancer:innen und KI-Tools zur Skalierung des Outputs
   
   

Das zeichnet mich aus:


 * Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Brand Management, idealerweise im Ingredient Branding oder in B2B- und Deep-Tech-Umfeldern
 * Die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Innovationen in präzise Narrative für diverse Stakeholder zu übersetzen
 * Nachweisbare Erfolge in internationaler Pressearbeit und im Aufbau von Thought Leadership für C-Level
 * Hands-on-Mentalität und konsequente Priorisierung nach strategischem Impact
 * Teamplayer-Mentalität und Lust auf Startup-Umfeld, mit Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit mit Business Development Team
 * Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools, um Output als Solo-Funktion zu skalieren
   
   

Das erwartet mich bei eeden:


 * Ich baue die Marke eines Unternehmens auf, das neue Standards in der textilen Kreislaufwirtschaft setzt, mit hoher Sichtbarkeit und Gestaltungsspielraum von Tag eins.
 * Ich übernehme früh strategische Verantwortung und entwickle die Funktion gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen weiter.
 * Ich erhalte eine wettbewerbsfähige Bezahlung, eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie ein jährliches Gesundheitsbudget. Zudem profitiere ich von einem Zuschuss zum EGYM Wellpass, dem Deutschland-Ticket oder einer lokalen Wertkarte sowie der Möglichkeit zum Bikeleasing.
 * Ein starkes Team mit einer offenen, wertschätzenden Kultur, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer engen Zusammenarbeit zwischen den technischen und kommerziellen Bereichen
 * Meine Arbeit trägt direkt dazu bei, eine funktionierende Kreislaufwirtschaft sichtbar und marktfähig zu machen.
   
   

Über uns

Jede Sekunde landet eine LKW-Ladung Alttextilien auf Deponien oder in der Verbrennung - völlig unnötig, oder? Wir bei eeden haben eine bessere Lösung: We enable circular textiles.

Mit unserer patentierten Recyclingtechnologie verwandeln wir ausgediente Textilien in hochwertige Rohstoffe, aus denen neue Kleidung entsteht. Seit unserer Gründung arbeiten wir tagtäglich gemeinsam daran, unsere Technologie weiterzuentwickeln und weltweit nutzbar zu machen! Bei uns packt jede:r mit an, spricht Dinge offen an und lernt aus Fehlern. Dank unserer vielfältigen Perspektiven und Talente finden wir gemeinsam die besten Lösungen - und dabei zählt jede Idee. Vielleicht ja bald auch deine?

Wenn du einen Job suchst, bei dem du wirklich etwas bewirken kannst, dann werde Teil unseres Teams!

title: Digital Content Manager
description:
About the job

At Joie, we design thoughtful, high-quality baby gear that supports families through everyday moments and meaningful milestones. Our products are created to make life with little ones simpler, smarter, and more enjoyable.




As part of a global portfolio of leading juvenile brands, Joie serves families across EMEA, APAC, and the Americas, delivering accessible, well-crafted products that combine global brand consistency with local relevance.




We are seeking a Digital Content Manager (m/f/d) to lead Joie’s global digital content strategy across social media, websites, and email, delivering a consistent and high-quality brand experience across markets.




This role serves as the key link between the global brand team, regional marketing teams, and e-commerce partners, ensuring content is scalable, locally adaptable, and aligned with business priorities.




As both a strategic leader and people manager, the Digital Content Manager will establish content standards, optimize processes, and develop a high-performing team to deliver measurable engagement and business results.




*Please note that this is a full-time onsite position, and attendance in the office is required Monday through Friday.




What you'll do

Global Content Strategy & Planning

•Own Joie’s global digital content strategy across social, web, and email channels

•Build, maintain, and govern a single, integrated global content calendar across digital channels

•Lead cross-functional planning with regional marketing teams and ecommerce partners to align product launches, campaigns, and key commercial moments

•Balance global brand consistency and priorities with regional market needs, enabling effective localization




Social Media Leadership

•Own and evolve Joie’s global organic social media strategy across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and emerging platforms

•Oversee global social content planning and execution in alignment with the broader global content calendar

•Manage and develop the Social Media Manager, including goal setting, performance management, and capability development s

•Ensure global social content is built for scalability and localization across subsidiaries and distributor markets

•Partner with PR and customer service teams to establish clear community management standards and escalation protocols




Website Content Oversight

•Oversee global brand content across EMEA, LATAM, and APAC Joie websites, in partnership with regional teams, IT and ecommerce

•Manage and develop the Website Coordinator, driving clear priorities, workflows, and quality standards

•Ensure website content aligns with global brand storytelling, campaign priorities, commercial objectives, and content timing

•Optimize content to effectively communicate product features, merchandiss across the range, and help consumer decision making




Email Marketing Collaboration

•Partner with the EU ecommerce team on global and regional email marketing initiatives

•Ensure alignment of email content with broader campaign strategy and global content calendar

•Review and approve email content and design to ensure consistency with brand standards




Platforms, Tools & Governance

•Own Joie’s digital content and social media platforms (e.g., Hootsuite and related tools)

•Establish scalable workflows, governance models, and onboarding processes for regional teams

•Evaluate and implement tools to improve content planning, execution, and reporting

leadership & performance

•Lead, coach, and develop a small global digital content team

•Define, track and report on digital content KPIs tied to brand and commercial outcomes

•Deliver clear, actionable insights to global marketing leadership

•Contribute to long-term planning for content scalability, channel evolution, and capability building







What you'll bring

•6-9+ years of experience in digital content, social media, or digital marketing roles

•Fluent in English (required)

•Fluent in German strongly preferred

•Proven people leadership experience, including direct management and development of team members

•Experience operating in global or multi-market environments

•Strong understanding of content strategy across social, web, and email

•Experience managing digital platforms and content workflows

•Highly organized with strong communication and stakeholder management skills







What You’ll Get:

 * Dynamic Global Environment: Gain hands-on experience in a rapidly growing international company, with exposure to global best practices.
 * Diverse & Supportive Team: Collaborate with a talented, multicultural team and learn from a wide range of professional backgrounds.
 * Professional Development: Grow your skills and career while working with by industry experts.

title: Senior Category Manager
description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?





We are Emma - The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 35 markets and more than 15 retail stores across Europe. 








Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide. 








It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together. 








Ready to awaken your best with us? 





 




This is an exciting opportunity to join Emma and our E-commerce team. As a Senior Category Manager for Germany, you will own the business performance of your market from end to end. You’ll define the strategy, drive growth, and shape the customer experience. You will be a key player in our E-Commerce Europe team, contributing to cross-country and cross-functional initiatives, with regular exposure to senior leadership.  






What you´ll do:

   
   
 * Own the P&L of the Product Categories in Germany with a focus on profitable growth and margin expansion.  
   
   
 * Define and execute the category strategy for one of the categories (Mattresses, Beds, and Accessories)—adapting the global assortment to the local market and uncovering new segment opportunities.  
   
   
 * Drive Pricing Excellence: Own the local pricing strategy across channels and products to maximize revenue and margin, supported by strong analytics.  
   
   
 * Lead Go-To-Market Initiatives for new product launches in Germany —collaborating with Global Product Success, Sourcing, Marketing, and UX teams.  
   
   
 * Manage the Full Product Lifecycle: Plan and coordinate phase-ins/phase-outs, ensuring timely and cost-effective portfolio evolution.  
   
   
 * Run Campaign & Commercial Planning in alignment with your Marketing counterpart, ensuring a coherent and impactful promotional calendar.  
   
   
 * Partner with Regional Webshop Team to improve digital conversion and category presentation.  
   
   
 * Collaborate with Operations and Sourcing to improve cost structure and supply performance for the German market
   
   
 * Act as a Category Expert for the German business, providing insights, benchmarking, and recommendations to the local leadership team.  
   
   
   
   
   
   





Who we´re looking for:

   
   
 * You have a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Marketing, Economics, Business Development, Management, or E-commerce
   
   
 * You have 2+ years of experience in Category Management, Business Strategy, or Consulting, ideally in e-commerce, retail, or consumer goods
   
   
 * You’ve owned or contributed significantly to P&L performance Strategic & Analytical Thinker
   
   
 * You’re able to connect the dots between customer insights, product performance, pricing dynamics, and operational levers to define high-impact growth strategies. Business Ownership Mindset
   
   
 * You thrive on responsibility, take full ownership of your domain, and act with a founder’s mentality in identifying growth and profitability opportunities. Strong Commercial Acumen
   
   
 * You understand pricing, margin drivers, channel dynamics, and portfolio management deeply enough to make data-driven decisions that move the business forward. Execution-Oriented Leader
   
   
 * You’re not only great at planning but also at making things happen cross-functionally. You align teams, manage dependencies, and follow through with high standards
   
   
 * Collaborative & Influential
   
   
 * You can navigate and align diverse stakeholders across global, regional, and local teams
   
   
 * You lead through influence and structured communication
   
   
 * Comfortable with Ambiguity - As part of a fast-scaling environment, you know how to operate in changing settings, solve problems creatively, and adapt quickly
   
   
 * Fluency in English is required for this role
   
   
   
   
   
   





What we offer:

   
   
 * Pet-friendly environment, where you can bring your furry desk buddy; 
   
   
 * Discounts on our top-notch products;  
   
   
 * 25 days holidays / year +1 day/year at Emma (max. 30 days); 
   
   
 * The opportunity to collaborate with multinational teams; 
   
   
 * Exciting events that aren't just team-building exercises but opportunities to create epic memories; 
   
   
 * All the tools you need to grow and ownership from the beginning. 
   
   
   
   
   
   








Become an Emmie





We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.  








We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age. 








Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgement. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: International Management Trainee in Marketing
description:

To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!

In this 18-months program, you will work on cross-functional and cross-market projects within Central Europe as BAT’s second largest area, including the end markets Germany, Poland, Austria, Switzerland, Hungary, Slovakia and Czech Republic.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include


 * Gather exciting experiences from different rotations within Marketing department (e.g. Digital, E-Commerce, Offline Activation, Brand or Trade Marketing) in our German headquarters in Hamburg.

 * Help us shape our Marketing agenda and strategy to transform our business and contribute your own ideas on projects that make us best in class and drive forward our various brands like Lucky Strike, Pall Mall and Dunhill as well as our new category brands glo, Vuse and VELO™
 * Drive your learning curve by working cross-functionally and managing different stakeholders from peers to senior managers.
 * Get to know our sales business from scratch with a rotation in our Field Force
   
   

What are we looking for?

 * First functional experience as an intern or working student (min. 4 months)
 * International experience, e.g. through a semester or internship abroad (min. 4 months)
 * A courageous and passionate personality with strong communicative, conceptual and analytical skills
 * Strong international career aspirations and mobility
 * A sound leadership mindset
   
   

What we offer you?


 * Starting Salary 55.800€ + annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)
 * Our range of benefits include full subsidy of transportation or coverage of your Urban Sports Club membership, plus access to corporate benefits.
 * Diverse development opportunities Internal career advancement, access to digital learning platforms, and personalized training programs to support your leadership journey.

Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.
 * You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills
 * We prioritize continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changes
 * Hybrid work flexible work time and home-office options
 * One of the best office spaces in downtown Hamburg with breathtaking views of the Alster, a state-of-the-art work environment, and a dedicated oasis area for relaxation. Celebrate your successes at regular after-work events and office parties
   
   

WHY JOIN BAT?

We’re one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.

Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.

We see the career breaks as opportunities not obstacles. Through The Global Returners program, we support professionals looking to restart their careers after an extended absence from the workforce (e.g. time out caring for family, parental leave, national service, sabbatical and/or starting an own venture).

Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.

If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best during the recruitment process, you are encouraged to notify us. We are fully committed to support you by making appropriate arrangements for you to demonstrate your full potential.

title: Senior Director Innovation Apparel - CD&I (m/f/d)
description:

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Standort: Remote (Arbeite von überall)

Anstellungsart: Freiberuflich / Auf Projektbasis* (40 Stunden/Woche)

Erfahrungslevel: Fortgeschrittener – Senior

Vergütung: $3,500 – $5,500/Monat + Performance Bonus




Über uns

Wir sind eine schnell wachsende E-Commerce-Gruppe mit mehreren erfolgreichen Brands. Unsere Hauptmarke ist Luuma (shopluuma.de) — eine deutsche Skincare-Brand, die durch performancestarke Werbung auf Facebook, Instagram und TikTok aufgebaut wurde. Wir investieren aktuell einen sechsstelligen Betrag monatlich in Ads — und wir wachsen weiter.

Unser Team besteht aus motivierten Menschen, die remote aus der ganzen Welt arbeiten. Wir setzen hohe Maßstäbe an unsere Creative-Arbeit und investieren gezielt in Menschen, die Ergebnisse liefern — zwei unserer Teammitglieder sind seit über einem Jahr dabei und wachsen gemeinsam mit uns.




Die Stelle

Wir suchen einen Creative Strategist, der Performance Advertising in- und auswendig kennt. Du weißt, was Menschen beim Scrollen stoppt, welche Angles bei einer Skincare-Zielgruppe funktionieren und wie man aus einem starken Insight ein Konzept macht, das skaliert.

Dies ist eine reine Strategy- und Concepting-Rolle — die Produktion übernimmt unser Team aus 11 Video-Editoren. Deine Aufgabe ist es, die Ideen zu entwickeln, die Konzepte zu schreiben, die Ads zu skripten und den finalen Output zu reviewen. Kein Editing erforderlich.

Du arbeitest eng mit unseren 2 Creative Directors zusammen, die aktuell die gesamte Creative Strategy selbst verantworten — du lernst also direkt von Menschen, die wissen, was in der Praxis funktioniert. Sie begleiten dich mit konstantem Feedback, klaren Performance-Insights und echtem Interesse an deiner Entwicklung.




Deine Aufgaben

 * Entwicklung performancestarker Ad-Konzepte und Creative Angles für eine deutsche Skincare-Brand
 * Schreiben detaillierter Skripte und Creative Briefs in verschiedenen Formaten — darunter UGC, Mashups, Storytelling Mashups und mehr
 * Review der finalen Edits sowie Feedback und Revision Notes an das Produktionsteam
 * Analyse von Performance-Daten, um zu erkennen was funktioniert und winning Konzepte weiterzuentwickeln
 * Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Creative Directors, um die kreative Messlatte kontinuierlich höher zu legen




Das bringst du mit

Voraussetzungen:

 * Fließende Deutschkenntnisse — alle Konzepte und Skripte werden auf Deutsch verfasst
 * Gute Englischkenntnisse — Englisch ist unsere interne Teamsprache
 * Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Performance Advertising, idealerweise für DTC E-Commerce Brands oder eine Performance Marketing Agentur
 * Tiefes Verständnis für den Aufbau von Paid Social Ads — Hooks, Storytelling, CTAs
 * Ein gutes Gespür dafür, was bei einer Consumer-Zielgruppe ankommt
 * Fähigkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten, den eigenen Workflow zu managen und Deadlines einzuhalten
 * Kommunikationsstärke und schnelle Erreichbarkeit

Von Vorteil:

 * Erfahrung im Skincare- oder Beauty-Bereich
 * Verständnis von Facebook- und TikTok-Ad-Metriken und wie Creatives die Performance beeinflussen
 * Erfahrung mit UGC- oder Influencer-Style Content Konzepten




Das bieten wir dir

 * $3,500 – $5,500/Monat basierend auf Erfahrung und Qualität der Arbeit
 * Performance Bonus on top — prozentuale Beteiligung am Ad Spend deiner winning Konzepte
 * Flexible Arbeitszeiten — du entscheidest, wann du arbeitest
 * Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit 2 erfahrenen Creative Directors, die selbst aktiv Strategie schreiben und in deine Entwicklung investiert sind
 * Vollständige Transparenz über alle Performance-Daten — du weißt immer, wie deine Konzepte laufen
 * Ein Team aus 11 dedizierten Video-Editoren — du fokussierst dich ausschließlich auf Strategy und Concepting, kein Editing
 * Ein unterstützendes Team, das Wissen offen teilt und füreinander da ist
 * Wöchentlicher Team-Call zur gemeinsamen Abstimmung über alle Brands hinweg
 * Langfristige Zusammenarbeit mit der Option auf eine Festanstellung für die richtige Person
 * Vollständig remote — arbeite von wo du möchtest

Tools die wir nutzen: Notion, Slack, Air.inc und weitere




So bewirbst du dich

Klicke auf „Bewerben", um deine Bewerbung direkt über diesen Beitrag einzureichen. Wir prüfen jede Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns bei passenden Kandidaten.




*Diese Stelle ist eine freiberufliche Tätigkeit auf Honorarbasis (40h/Woche). Die anfallenden Steuern und Sozialabgaben sind eigenverantwortlich im jeweiligen Wohnsitzland zu entrichten.

 * Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid mit mindestens 2 Tagen Office pro Woche im modernen C1

title: Regional Marketing Program Manager
description:
This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Regional Marketing Program Manager in Germany.

This is a dynamic opportunity for a marketing professional who thrives at the intersection of events, content, and partner engagement within a B2B SaaS environment. The role focuses on driving regional marketing programs across Western Europe, with a strong emphasis on events, webinars, and field marketing initiatives that generate pipeline and strengthen brand presence. You will play a central role in coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, including sales teams, external partners, and prospective customers, ensuring a seamless and impactful event experience. Beyond execution, you will shape messaging and storytelling through compelling copywriting and targeted campaign content. The position offers a high level of ownership in a remote-first environment, where autonomy, creativity, and attention to detail are essential. It is ideal for someone who enjoys managing multiple programs simultaneously while directly contributing to business growth in a fast-paced, international setting.

Accountabilities


 * Plan, coordinate, and execute a comprehensive regional event and webinar calendar across Western Europe, including in-person events, partner roadshows, and virtual sessions.
 * Manage end-to-end event execution, including logistics, vendor coordination, budgeting, platform setup, and performance tracking.
 * Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and task lists to ensure seamless delivery of all marketing programs and events.
 * Serve as the primary marketing liaison for regional partners, supporting co-marketing initiatives and joint event execution.
 * Coordinate closely with sales teams to ensure proper tracking, scoring, and follow-up of event-generated leads and attendees.
 * Create compelling copy for landing pages, email campaigns, social media posts, and webinar promotional materials.
 * Adapt global messaging to local Western European audiences within the B2B SaaS and location intelligence space.
 * Lead regional email marketing initiatives, including campaign setup, A/B testing, optimization, and performance analysis.
 * Monitor and analyze marketing metrics to evaluate event performance and improve future campaign effectiveness.
 * Ensure consistent, high-quality communication with customers, prospects, and VIP attendees before, during, and after events.
   
   

Requirements


 * 3-5 years of experience in B2B marketing, with a strong focus on event marketing, field marketing, or program management.
 * Experience within B2B SaaS, GIS, mapping technology, or location intelligence environments is highly preferred.
 * Proven track record of managing both virtual webinars and in-person events, including trade shows or customer conferences.
 * Strong copywriting and content creation skills, with the ability to translate technical topics into engaging marketing messaging.
 * Hands-on experience with email marketing tools, marketing automation platforms, and campaign performance optimization.
 * Strong analytical skills with experience tracking KPIs, reporting results, and using data to improve marketing outcomes.
 * Excellent organizational and project management abilities with a strong attention to detail and execution discipline.
 * Ability to work independently in a remote or hybrid, cross-border environment across Western Europe.
 * Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence in coordinating external partners and internal teams.
 * Fluency in English is required; additional fluency in German or French is a strong advantage.
   
   

Benefits


 * Fully remote role with flexibility across Western European time zones.
 * Opportunity to lead high-impact regional marketing programs in a fast-growing B2B tech environment.
 * Exposure to international cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, and partner organizations.
 * Ownership of end-to-end event and campaign execution with measurable business impact.
 * Career development opportunities in a specialized SaaS and location intelligence industry.
 * Dynamic and collaborative work culture that values initiative, creativity, and autonomy.

title: Marketing Manager (Germany) (m/f/d)
description:
Job Title: Marketing Manager – Germany

Location: Remote (Germany-based)

Salary: €55.000-€65.000 per annum




About Us

Kendamil is one of the fastest-growing infant nutrition brands worldwide, trusted by parents in over 50 countries. Family-owned and proudly made in the UK, we’ve revolutionized the formula market with our unique whole milk recipe. Our products are available in major retailers globally, including Target, Walmart, Boots, and Tesco. With ambitious plans to expand into new markets and product categories, we are seeking an International Brand Executive to support our brand growth and deliver consistent, impactful marketing across multiple countries.




About the role

The Marketing Manager Germany will play a key role in shaping, executing, and optimizing our full 360° marketing plan as we launch and scale Kendamil across the German market. You will own the German brand plan end‑to‑end -from annual planning and budget ownership to campaign development, measurement, and continuous optimization.




Working closely with the Germany Country Manager, Global Marketing Director and our global marketing teams, you will ensure Kendamil shows up with cultural relevance, brand consistency, and best‑in‑class execution across every consumer and shopper touchpoint, whilst building your department. This role requires deep consumer marketing experience, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to translate insights into high‑impact brand‑building activity.




This is a role for a hands-on, experienced FMCG marketer who is comfortable leading strategy while managing execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.




Key responsibilities

 * Own and execute the German brand and growth strategy across digital, retail, influencer, and shopper channels
 * Drive integrated campaigns, media planning, and KPI performance to accelerate brand awareness and conversion
 * Localise global marketing initiatives with strong German consumer, cultural, and regulatory insight
 * Lead NPD go-to-market execution, launch strategy, and retail activation across key German accounts
 * Build high-impact influencer, partnership, and community programs with measurable ROI
 * Deliver data-driven marketing performance analysis, budget management, and commercial insights
 * Partner cross-functionally with Global, Sales, Supply, and agency teams to ensure best-in-class execution
 * Represent a fast-growing international brand within the German market and retail landscape




Qualification and experience:

 * 5+ years of experience in consumer marketing, preferably within FMCG, baby, wellness, nutrition, or lifestyle categories.
 * Proven ownership of annual brand plans, integrated campaigns, and full marketing budgets.
 * Proven trade experience with major German grocers including DM, Rossman, Edeka and Rewe.

title: Account Manager - Retail
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is a technology company that makes it incredibly easy to discover and get the best restaurants, grocery stores and other local shops delivered to home or to the office. Our local commerce platform makes it easy for customers to order whatever they need on one app, for merchants to make additional sales, and for couriers to make meaningful earnings flexibly. To enable this, Wolt develops a wide range of technologies from local commerce platform to retail software and financial solutions, as well as operates its own grocery stores under the brand Wolt Market. Wolt was founded in 2014 and joined forces with DoorDash in 2022. DoorDash operates in 27 countries today, 23 of which are with the Wolt product and brand.

However, food delivery was just the start. We don’t want to just satisfy our customers’ hunger, but to deliver a wide variety of products and expand our platform to supermarkets, flowers, toys, books and other exciting products, all referred to as Retail. Your job starts when the retail partner has signed the contract and has been onboarded to Wolt’s platform. As a Retail Account Manager, you’re responsible for managing and developing your portfolio of our key retail partners in Germany. We’re looking for someone with a genuine passion for establishing relationships and improving key business metrics to create results for Wolt, the retail partners, and ultimately the customers. In doing that, you need to have good problem-solving skills, a commercial mindset and a strong passion to deliver exceptional service. If you want to use those skills to digitally enable local brick & mortar stores, you have come to the right place!

On a personal note, it goes without saying that you’re a team player and willing to get your hands dirty as we build this relatively new area of our business in Germany. This also means that you must thrive in the ‘start-up’ environment where constant change means there is always lots to get your teeth into!

What you will be doing


 * Owning the overall partner relationship and driving growth with our retail partners by improving their performance through data driven consultation
 * Identifying the focus area in your portfolio and invest into high-potential partnerships
 * Drive forward operational improvement with your partners to ensure that together we are delivering the best experience for Wolt’s end customers
 * Engage partners in growth conversations (i.e. adding more stores to Wolt across Germany, increasing same-store sales, improving profitability, expanding with new brands, category management and maximizing product inventory on Wolt etc)
 * Working closely together with the marketing team to plan and execute campaigns together with retail partners
 * Take ownership for projects that help us evolve our retail business. Project goals may vary from driving efficiency over ensuring legal compliance to solving challenges with product data.
 * Getting your hands dirty: we’re developing a lot from scratch and you will help to bring structure in how we support our partners
   
   

Our humble expectation


 * Bachelor or higher degree and job experience with account and/or category management (2-3 years) with a strong drive to grow and develop in this field
 * Fluent in German and English is a must to connect with our partners
 * Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to adapt the tone to suit the audience
 * Commercial mindset with very good analytical and problem-solving skills
 * Structured, detailed, proactive and service-oriented
 * High sense of ownership and ambition to go beyond the obvious
 * Experience in retail and/or with e-commerce and marketplaces is an advantage
   
   

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Business Development Manager

Electric Vehicles (EV)

Germany - Remote Working with travel around Germany




The Business Development Manager will be responsible for creating buy-in for the product vision for Electric Vehicle (EV) business for Royal Enfield, both internally and with key external partners. The incumbent will lead the development of the EV product and positioning strategies along with the Product Strategy Teams, manage scope and prioritize activities based on business and customer impact, drive product launches including working with the communications team, executives, and other product/brand/channel management.




Responsibilities:

 * Act as a product evangelist and an in-house EV expert with complete ownership of RE’s EV product channel, to build awareness and understanding.
 * Work closely with teams like EV regional/central, Product Strategy, Product Development, Brand Managers, Operations, Marketing and Commercial stakeholders to draw on your market insight, guide our strategic decisions, and shape how our business works to deliver with quick time-to-market and optimal resources.
 * Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes.
 * Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that improve customer experience and drive growth.
 * Development of brand activations, channel partnerships including aspects of overseeing brand initiatives
 * Develop the channel network strategy, making them stable sales channels, motivated to introduce new products in the market
 * Create and execute an annual brand plan for Royal Enfield EV offerings to build brand awareness & aspiration through the brand’s positioning in priority markets.
 * Strategize, plan and lead the execution of brand portfolio strategy and develop relevant campaigns
 * Liaison with content & digital team to develop and disseminate communication for various initiatives
 * Represent the company by visiting customers to solicit feedback on company products and services.
 * Engaging our customers and bringing to life the benefits of using our electric vehicle solutions over traditional options.
 * Implement new systems or processes related to the management of EV Sales.




Experience/ Qualifications:

 * Degree Level Educated
 * 5+ years relevant experience including at least 3+ years in the sales field of an Automobile/motorcycle industry
 * Must be Fluent in English and German
 * Must have knowledge of the Electric Vehicle (EV) market




Royal Enfield - About Us:

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfields are engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach the brand calls Pure Motorcycling.




Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.




A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia.




Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

Read more about us: www.royalenfield.com

Our software is used by fast-growing Voice AI companies across Europe and the United States whose products require reliable performance at scale: call center agents, voice agents, telephony apps, and enterprise voice assistants. We believe voice will become the main interface for technology and ai-coustics is building the foundational infrastructure to make audio input reliable, measurable, and easy to deploy.


We are backed by leading early-stage investors including Connect Ventures, Partech, Inovia Capital, as well as angel investors from HuggingFace, DeepMind and Amazon with deep expertise in AI and developer infrastructure. These partners share our vision and are helping us build a world-class team operating with high levels of responsibility and velocity. We look for people who take ownership, think systemically, and want to solve challenging real-world problems in close collaboration with our customers. If you're motivated by developing technology that is used in practice, shaping an emerging category and setting a new standard for how voice AI works in the real world, you'll feel at home at ai-coustics.


Role Overview


We're looking for a Head of Marketing to own and scale ai-coustics' end-to-end marketing function as we define a new category in Voice AI infrastructure. Reporting directly to the CEO and partnering closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales/GTM, you'll set the strategy, build the team, and personally drive the work that establishes ai-coustics as the default reliability layer for Voice AI builders worldwide. You'll own positioning, demand generation, product marketing, content, brand, and developer marketing — and translate complex audio and AI capabilities into a sharp, technical narrative that resonates with developers, technical buyers, and executive decision-makers. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for someone who has built and scaled marketing functions at high-growth B2B / developer-first startups and is ready to do it again with full ownership.


Tasks

   
   
 * Define and own ai-coustics' marketing strategy end to end: positioning, messaging, ICP, category narrative, and marketing plan tied to revenue and pipeline goals
   
   
 * Build, lead and develop the marketing team (currently Growth & Content Marketer, Video Specialist, plus agency partners) and shape the org as we scale
   
   
 * Drive B2B demand generation across paid, GEO, lifecycle and partnerships, with clear ownership of pipeline contribution
   
   
 * Lead product marketing: launches, positioning, competitive intelligence, sales enablement, and launch materials
   
   
 * Own developer marketing in collaboration with DevRel and Engineering: documentation narrative, developer content, community presence, and ecosystem partnerships (LiveKit, voice AI platforms)
   
   
 * Set the content and editorial strategy across blog, case studies, technical guides, video, and thought leadership, ensuring everything is on-brand, technically credible, and built to perform
   
   
 * Run brand and category-building activities: events, PR, analyst relations, founder thought leadership, and flagship moments that establish ai-coustics as the reliability layer for Voice AI
   
   
 * Operate the marketing stack and reporting: instrument the funnel, set OKRs
   
   
 * Manage budget, agency relationships, and vendor selection with discipline; integrate AI tools natively across the team's workflow
   
   
 * Partner with Sales/GTM on pipeline coverage and partner with the CEO on fundraising narrative and investor-facing materials
   
   


Requirements

   
   
 * 5+ years of B2B marketing experience, including leadership experience at a high-growth startup or scale-up
   
   
 * Proven track record building and scaling marketing functions from early stage through Series A/B, ideally in developer tools, audio, or technical SaaS
   
   
 * Demonstrated ownership of a full-funnel demand gen engine with measurable impact on pipeline and revenue
   
   
 * Experience marketing to developers and technical buyers, with a strong point of view on developer-first content, community, and ecosystem motions
   
   
 * Strong product marketing instincts: you've led launches, sharpened positioning in noisy categories, and built sales enablement that closes deals
   
   
 * Excellent writer and editor; able to set the voice for the company and personally craft the highest-stakes narratives (launches, decks, exec briefings)
   
   
 * Hands-on with the modern marketing stack (HubSpot or equivalent CRM/MA, GA4, Ahrefs/Semrush, attribution tooling)
   
   
 * Experience hiring, coaching, and structuring small but high-leverage marketing teams; comfortable being both a builder and a player-coach
   
   
 * Strong cross-functional operator: works fluently with Product, Engineering, Sales, and the CEO, and can hold their own in technical conversations
   
   
 * Bonus: experience with Voice AI, speech, audio, real-time communications, or adjacent infra categories; experience supporting fundraising and investor / analyst relations
   
   


Benefits

   
   
 * Opportunity to lead marketing at a rapidly growing Voice AI startup, backed by top investors, at the moment a new category is being defined.
   
   
 * Compensation and equity: Competitive senior leadership package with meaningful stock options, enabling you to take part in the company's success.
   
   
 * Seat at the table: Report directly to the CEO and shape company strategy alongside Product, Engineering, and GTM leadership.
   
   
 * Startup Culture: Dynamic, fast-paced environment with passionate and collaborative colleagues.
   
   
 * High Impact: Groundbreaking startup at a pivotal growth stage, making a real difference in how people experience audio.
   
   
 * Ownership & Autonomy: Full ownership of the marketing function, strategy, team, and budget, with the trust to ship fast.
   
   
 * Work With the Best: World-class team of engineers and builders with ample room for professional growth.
   
   
 * Contribute to the Future: Define the landscape of Voice AI technology.
   
   


If you are ready to lead the charge in revolutionizing Voice AI and drive our startup to new heights, we would love to hear from you. Apply today to join the ai-coustics team!

title: Head of E-Commerce (m/f/d)
description:

title: Category Development Manager CSD (m/w/d)
description:
Verantwortlichkeiten

Rolle als Expert Advisor für Kunden (extern)


 * Agiert als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Kunden und gestaltet sowie sichert kurz- und langfristige Wachstumspläne gemeinsam mit dem mittleren und oberen Management.
 * Führt die Kategorieagenda über alle CSD-Marken und Partner hinweg bei Store-Projekten.
 * Treibt die Entwicklung einer klaren Kategorienvision über die CSD-Kategorie von PepsiCo und die Vertriebskanäle hinweg voran.
 * Bringt eine innovative Händlerperspektive ein und entwickelt überzeugende Verkaufsargumentationen, die auf Kunden- und Marktdaten basieren und in konkrete Shopper- und Consumer-Insights übersetzt werden.
 * Initiiert und leitet Category-Management-Projekte mit Kunden, um Wachstumspotenziale zu erschließen und messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen – Verbesserungen bei Sortiment, Regalumsetzung und Promotion-Wirksamkeit – und liefert dabei umsetzbare Erkenntnisse an Demand Acceleration (DX) und Vertrieb.
 * Arbeitet direkt mit Kunden oder über Vertriebspartner zusammen, um Kategoriepläne, Reviews und Wachstumschancen zu präsentieren.
 * Fungiert als wichtiger Beitragender bei der Vorbereitung nationaler T2T-Senior-Management-Meetings mit Kunden.
   
   

Kategorieexperte (intern)


 * Fungiert als internes Wissenszentrum und Kategorieexperte für eine spezifische Kategorie innerhalb der gesamten Organisation (Marketing, Vertrieb, Commercialization, Revenue Management, Sales Finance) sowie für ausgewählte Händler.
 * Verankert eine End-to-End-Markenperspektive in Projekten und im Tagesgeschäft und arbeitet eng mit Account Management (Vertrieb) und Marketing zusammen, um Category Pläne in starke Account-Pläne (AOP) zu überführen.
 * Entwickelt eine fundierte Sicht auf CSD-Kategorieauslieferungen und Forecasts zur Erreichung nationaler AOP-Ziele und kann die wichtigsten Treiber und Hemmnisse der Auslieferungen über Händler hinweg klar gegenüber dem mittleren und oberen Management erläutern.
 * Steuert die Kunden- und Kanal-Kategorieagenda kurz- und langfristig und nutzt dabei Category-Insights aus verschiedenen Quellen (z. B. Händler-, Shopper- und Verbrauchertrends; Nielsen, GfK und andere relevante Insight-Anbieter).
 * Leitet kundenbezogene Category- und anlassbasierte Projekte in interdisziplinären Teams.
 * Nimmt an funktionsübergreifenden Brand- und Account-Teams teil, indem Herausforderungen identifiziert, hochwertige Insights und Empfehlungen geliefert sowie die Entwicklung relevanter Produktinnovationen (NPDs) unterstützt werden.
 * Wirkt im Rahmen des jährlichen Planungszyklus (ACP/AOP) an strategischen Entscheidungen zu Innovationschancen und deren Umsetzung mit.
 * Entwickelt Sortiments- und Regalstrategien für die Kategorie und gibt klare Empfehlungen zu SKU-Rationalisierung, Facings vs. Sortimentsvielfalt, OOS-Analysen, Planogrammen, Game-Planning, SRP etc.
 * Arbeitet mit dem Space Management zusammen, um kundenspezifische Planogramme zu entwickeln.
   
   

Qualifikationen

Kenntnisse / Erfahrungen:


 * Hochschulabschluss bevorzugt in Wirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaft oder Management (als Haupt- oder Nebenfach); andere Studienrichtungen werden ebenfalls berücksichtigt.
 * Ca. 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing, Vertrieb, Category Management oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion.
 * Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch.
 * Ausgeprägte FMCG-Expertise, einschließlich tiefgehender Shopper-Insights und fundierter Kenntnisse der Kunden- und Handelslandschaft.
 * Starkes betriebswirtschaftliches Verständnis mit Fokus auf Geschäftsentwicklung sowie Vertriebs- und Marketingfunktionen; fundiertes Verständnis der Anforderungen und Treiber in Finance, Supply Chain und Außendienst*.
 * Hervorragende MS-Office-Kenntnisse.
 * Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Nielsen-/YouGov-/etc.-Tools und Kundenportalen.
   
   

Overview

At PepsiCo we’re more than just iconic brands — we’re a team of 2,000+ passionate people across 11 countries, working together to deliver great-tasting products that consumers enjoy every day.

With over 70 years in the region, we operate from 7 key locations — including 4 headquarters and 4 production sites — and offer a portfolio of 16 brands, from global icons like Pepsi and Lay’s to local favorites like Duyvis and Schwip Schwap. We’re committed to sustainability, innovation, and community impact. If you’re looking to grow your career with purpose, we’d love to hear from you.

The Category Development Manager CSD (Carbonated Soft Drinks) holds end-to-end responsibility for the total CSD category strategy across all banners, driving the commercial category agenda with mid- and senior-level management. He/She acts as a trusted advisor, ensuring category growth and building category management capabilities to support PepsiCo’s growth. He/She provides customer teams and customers with insights and recommendations to accelerate growth of PepsiCo’s CSD categories and, in doing so, helps drive PepsiCo sales.

The role was posted internally until 28.05.2026

Responsibilities

Expert Advisor role to Customers (external)


 * Acts as a trusted advisor to customers, shaping and securing short- and long-term growth plans with mid- and senior-level management.
 * Leads the category agenda across all CSD brands and partners on store projects.
 * Drives the development of a clear category vision across PepsiCo’s CSD category and sales channels.
 * Brings an innovative retailer mindset, creating compelling selling stories grounded in customer and market data and translated into shopper and consumer insights.
 * Initiates and leads category management projects with customers to unlock growth opportunities and deliver measurable results—improving assortment, shelf execution, and promotional effectiveness—while providing actionable insights to Demand Acceleration (DX) and Sales.
 * Works directly with customers, or via sales partners, to present category plans, reviews, and growth opportunities.
 * Serves as a key contributor to the preparation of national customer T2T Senior Management meetings.
   
   

Category expert (internal)


 * Serves as the internal knowledge hub and category expert for a specific category across the organization (Marketing, Sales, Commercialization, Revenue Management, Sales Finance) and for selected retailers.
 * Embeds the end-to-end brand mindset across projects and day-to-day work, partnering closely with Account Management (Sales) and Marketing to translate Category Plans into strong Account Plans (AOP).
 * Develops a point of view on CSD category shipments and forecasts to deliver national AOP targets, and can clearly explain key shipment drivers and drainers across retailers to mid- and senior-level management.
 * Leads the customer and channel category agenda in the short and long term, leveraging category insights derived from multiple sources (e.g., retailer, shopper, and consumer trends; Nielsen, GfK, and other relevant insight providers).
 * Leads customer category and occasion-based projects within a multidisciplinary team.
 * Participates in cross-functional Brand and Account teams by identifying issues, providing high-quality insights and guidance, and supporting the development of relevant new product innovations (NPDs).
 * Co-leads strategic decisions on innovation opportunities and implementation strategies as part of the annual planning cycle (ACP/AOP).
 * Develops the category assortment and shelving strategy, providing clear recommendations on SKU rationalization, facings vs. variety, OOS analysis, planograms, game-planning, SRP, etc.
 * Collaborates with Space Management to develop customer-specific planograms.
   
   

Qualifications

Qualifications :


 * University degree preferred in Applied Economics, Business, or Management (as a major or minor); other educational backgrounds to be considered.
 * ~5+ years of experience in Trade Marketing, Sales, Category Management, or a closely related function.
 * Languages: Business-fluent German and English.
 * Strong FMCG expertise, including deep shopper insights and strong customer/retail landscape knowledge.
 * Strong overall business acumen with a focus on business development and Sales and Marketing functions; solid understanding of Finance, Supply Chain, and Field Sales* needs and drivers.
 * Excellent MS Office skills.
 * Strong proficiency in Nielsen/YouGov/etc. tools and customer portals.
