title: Director Communications
description:
Responsibilities

The future is what you make it! When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers who make the things that make the future.

As part of our growth journey to become a best-in-class, pure-play automation technology company, we are hiring a Communications Director, based at one of our key sites in Frankfurt, Berlin or Ratingen, Germany.

The Role

The position is focused on telling our brand story to internal and external audiences in Germany, and will add additional support for our communications activities across continental Europe as required. It will report into the Senior Director of Communications for Latin America, Europe and the Middle East.

The Communications Director will partner closely with the Regional President and regional Comms leader, as well as our wider Communications function, to shape and deliver strategic, enterprise‑aligned communications that build awareness, deepen understanding, and inspire action across all internal and external stakeholders.

This is an individual contributor role focused on both hands-on execution and strategic impact for Europe, with a particular focus on telling our energy and automation technology stories to audiences in Germany.

The successful candidate will be experienced at and comfortable operating both as counsel to senior executives, and tactically across the full spectrum of communications activities. Editorial standard written and verbal communications skills in English and German are critical, along with a proven ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment with rapidly shifting priorities.

Deep experience in message development and localization is a must, as this position will help guide efforts to consistently develop creative, compelling, and human-focused content that connects Honeywell employees with each other, leaders, and the company’s strategic initiatives.

This person will have a deep understanding of the political, economic and technological shifts taking place in Germany and across continental Europe, and be skilled in mapping industry stories to these trends to provide local market relevance. They will bring outstanding media contacts across Germany’s business, financial, political and industrial press, and be experienced at leading integrated communications programs at key events and external positioning platforms.

Key Responsibilities


 * Identify, develop and implement a holistic internal and external communications strategy and communications plan for Honeywell in Germany aligned to business objectives and priorities, as it evolves to become one of the world’s leading pure-play automation companies.
 * Develop regional media programs that are strongly linked to business strategy, regional industry trends, and performance requirements.
 * Develop and execute Executive Positioning strategies for the Regional President and country executives to drive top-tier media coverage, employee engagement and visibility to further the company’s reputation.
 * Establish and maintain strong relationships with key reporters/media and manage media inquiries and interview requests.
 * Partner on message development and provide media training and coaching as appropriate for key executive spokespeople.
 * Develop and deploy new, innovative tactics in support of delivering compelling messaging to employees across the business.
 * Support major initiatives, organization transitions, leadership changes, and other transformation steps through innovative and effective communication plans that address the needs of varied audiences and stakeholders.
 * Coordinate and facilitate budget and vendor relationships, event management and project teams as appropriate.
 * Work with appropriate businesses, functions, and government relations on crisis and issues management.
 * Oversee and develop content for press releases, bylined articles, key messages, media statements, Q&A documents, and briefings.
 * Advocate for the Honeywell brand and live as a brand ambassador.
 * Champion AI within the Communications space.
 * Ability to travel 10 - 15% of the time.
   
   

Success Factors


 * Develop relationships with reporters/media, pitch news stories/ideas, manage journalist inquiries and serve as a media spokesperson.
 * Strong (AP style) writing skills, with the ability to develop clear, concise messages that align closely with corporate messaging.
 * Excellent verbal communication skills and the ability to present effectively to senior management.
 * The ability to think strategically, provide communications counsel, and lead in developing plans to drive results.
 * Ability to identify issues proactively and execute actions to eliminate or minimize their potential impact.
 * Self-starter with ability to thrive in a matrix organizational structure where priorities can shift quickly.
 * Excellent project management and the ability to simultaneously prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines.
 * Intimate understanding of social media, especially LinkedIn, and an advanced understanding of how best to leverage channels such as Viva Engage to promote employee engagement.
 * Strong business acumen and partnering, consulting and influencing skills with the ability to build and navigate relationships at all levels of the organization, particularly at the executive level.
 * 12-15 years’ B2B communications experience is preferred, including senior level work in large, complex international companies.
   
   

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Join us now and be part of a global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers who make the things that make the future!

#TheFutureIsWhatWeMakeIt

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

title: Junior Social Media Manager - Gastro & Lifestyle
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Personal Branding & Strategy: You will refine and evolve our founder’s digital identity, proactively pitching "outside-the-box" ideas that set us apart from the competition.

 * Platform Management: You will curate and manage our channels with a platform-specific approach-maintaining professional business communication on LinkedIn while creating viral entertainment on TikTok.
 * Community Building: You will engage with our community, manage interactions, and use analytics to optimize performance.

Dein Profil

 * Mindset: You are trend-conscious, bold in trying new formats, and highly self-motivated.

Warum wir?

The Hype is still Real: Become part of one of the trendiest food concepts in Germany.

We are continuously looking for passionate people to help us improve our culinary offering. If you have a passion for hospitality and want to make every guest feel special, we look forward to receiving your application!

Grow with us…

Wen Cheng is a restaurant concept that offers traditional Chinese hand-pulled noodles. Since 2021, we have developed rapidly with four locations in Berlin. A culinary hype that leaves both our guests and us wanting more. Behind our five locations is a brand with over 150 employees from different nations.

Wen Cheng is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and strives to attract, develop and retain talented people from diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Join our team!

title: Senior Creative Lead (Digital Content)
description:
Lovehoney Group is the world’s leading sexual wellbeing company, with the mission to elevate pleasure through innovative technologies, a data-driven approach, and foster creative and fresh perspectives on intimacy. We offer exciting brands with innovative, high-quality sex toys, lingerie, and accessories in a streamlined online shopping experience.

At Lovehoney, we employ over 800 passionate and progressive individuals across 11 global offices, each person contributing a unique blend of talents to our diverse workforce. We are proud to be a company that thrives by doing things differently, challenging expectations and stereotypes while making a positive impact on our customers’ lives.

Join us at Lovehoney, where pleasure combines with creativity, data, and innovation!

We are looking for a commercially driven and strategically minded Senior Creative Lead (Digital Content) to lead our digital-first creative output across paid and organic channels. Video creative is a core pillar of our long-term strategy, so the successful candidate must bring production experience and be able to deliver content that both inspires and performs. You will lead a team responsible for creating high-impact assets across paid social, campaign activity, and always-on content systems. This role requires a strong understanding of social-first advertising, platform dynamics, and performance-led creative iteration. You should be just as comfortable developing big campaign ideas, potentially involving A-list celebrity talent, as you are building scalable test-and-learn ad frameworks that optimise performance across platforms. Reporting to the Marketing Director and working closely with Social Advertising, Owned Social, Brand, and wider eCommerce teams, you will ensure creative output is closely aligned with commercial objectives, data insights, and platform best practices, while championing a culture of iteration, experimentation, and continuous improvement through the use of data and emerging technologies, including AI.

What You Will Do


 * Lead and develop a high-performing digital creative team, fostering a culture of creativity, accountability, and commercial impact.
 * Own the end-to-end creative strategy for paid social and digital content, ensuring all output is optimised for performance and aligned with business goals.
 * Partner closely with Social Advertising teams to develop and iterate high-volume, performance-driven creative tailored to platform algorithms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube).
 * Oversee the development of both large-scale campaign concepts (including celebrity and influencer-led work) and scalable ad creative systems.
 * Translate performance data, audience insights, and testing learnings into actionable creative direction.
 * Drive the production of high-quality, platform-native content at scale, balancing speed, efficiency, and creative excellence.
 * Champion innovation in formats, messaging, and creative processes, including the use of AI and automation tools – partnering with agencies, photographers and developing content via our in-house studio.
 * Mentor and develop team members as a player-coach, raising the bar for both creative quality and performance thinking.
 * Stay ahead of platform trends, creative best practices, and evolving consumer behaviours to inform strategy.
   
   
   

What You Should Bring


 * Proven experience in a senior creative leadership role, with a strong track record in performance-driven digital content, production (scripting, shooting, editing) and liaising with agency partners.
 * Deep understanding of social platform mechanics and how creative drives performance within algorithmic environments.
 * Demonstrated experience developing both brand-led campaigns and high-volume, iterative ad creative.
 * Strong commercial mindset, with the ability to connect creative decisions to business outcomes and ROI.
 * A hands-on operator with the ability to work closely with teams to deliver output—not just set direction and help train them to raise their technical capacity as a whole.
 * Confidence using data and insights to inform creative strategy and workflow optimisation.
 * Familiarity with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance creative production and scalability.
 * Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
 * Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment with multiple priorities.
   
   
   

What We Can Offer You


 * A welcoming workplace full of drinks, snacks, friendly faces and fun team-building events.
 * Access to unique discounts at high street retailers, hotels, and service providers, in addition to a 50% discount on all Lovehoney products to explore and discover new ways to have fun.
 * Enjoy a hybrid work model that fosters flexibility and work-life balance, with three days per week in-office and the opportunity to work remotely for up to 4 weeks per year, alongside 25 days’ holiday, plus an additional day for each year you are with Lovehoney, providing ample time for relaxation, rejuvenation, and exploration.
 * Access to customized training opportunities to support your unique learning journey, complemented by biannual feedback cycles, offering valuable insights into your performance and growth areas, enhancing your development within the company.
 * Recognising the significance of physical and mental health, we proudly provide gym benefits in addition to a mental wellbeing platform, to ensure our employees thrive both professionally and personally.
 * Stay secure at work and at home with a complimentary 1Password Family account. All Lovehoney Group employees can invite up to five family members to join, offering your household a safe and simple way to manage passwords and sensitive information safely and easily.
   
   
   

Our interview process


 * CV review
 * Interview with one of Talent Acquisition Team Members
 * Hiring Manager Interview
 * Task
 * Hiring Team Interview and Task Presentation
   
   
   

Lovehoney Group is an equal opportunities employer. We promise that every qualified person will be evaluated according to skills regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

If you require accommodations during the interview process due to a disability, please inform your Talent Acquisition Specialist so that we can ensure a smooth and inclusive experience for all candidates.

At Lovehoney Group, we embrace innovative technologies to enhance our recruitment process. We leverage artificial intelligence during screening interviews for CV reviews and note-taking. We prioritize transparency and respect your preferences, so you'll have the option to opt out of recording and AI-driven note-taking while still receiving full and fair consideration for the role.

If we sparked your interest and you are open to embarking on your professional path with us, please visit our Lovehoney careers page to apply: https://jobs.eu.lever.co/lovehoneygroup

Our privacy policy is available here: https://www.lovehoneygroup.com/privacy-policy/

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
